expected_desired_snapshot_fingerprint.description: Full authoritative eligible-preflight snapshot fingerprint, never a client-derived selected subset.

expected_resolved_device_ids.description: Sorted full authoritative preflight candidate scope: every explicitly manual return_to_contour device, including candidates currently unavailable.

device_ids.description: Optional sorted selected subset of expected_resolved_device_ids. An explicit selection may include an unavailable candidate, which is durably deferred without dispatch; omission means return every currently available candidate only.

snapshot_token.description: Opaque token echoed from the full authoritative eligible preflight.
